DeathMask.name: Angel Devoid: Face of the Enemy
DeathMask.summary: A cyberpunk point-and-click action-adventure with a dynamic attitude system used during conversations to bring forth different responses. Sticking to one "alignment" is not wise.

Idol Mahjong - Final Romance R.name: Idol-Mahjong: Final Romance R
Idol Mahjong - Final Romance R.summary: The third entry in the Idol Mahjong series.

Ryuuteki Gosennen - Dragons of China.name: Ryuuteki Gosennen: Dragons of China
Ryuuteki Gosennen - Dragons of China.summary: Ryuuteki Gosennen: Dragons of China () is an adventure game for the Sega Saturn.

Shadows of the Tusk.name: Shadows of the Tusk
Shadows of the Tusk.summary: A turn-based "deck building" strategy game for the Sega Saturn. It was the only turn-based strategy game on the system to support Seganet's X-Band.
